seo.title: ReportAI — From audio to report, without touching a template
seo.description: Send a voice note over Telegram, WhatsApp or email and get the meeting minutes or visit report filled into your company's own Word template. With human review before anything is sent.

cta.mailSubject: I want to become a ReportAI client

hero.subheadline: ReportAI transcribes what you say, fills in the Word template your company already uses, and delivers the document to the right person. Over Telegram, WhatsApp or email.
hero.note: No new app, no video call, no generic templates.

values.decision: Accept the 15% quarterly volume increase by reducing the delivery window to two weeks.

noApp.title: Nothing to install
noApp.body: Works inside Telegram, WhatsApp or the email your team already uses.

yourTemplate.title: Your template, as is
yourTemplate.body: Upload your .docx and it gets filled with your format, your logo, your sections.

approval.title: Nothing goes out without your OK
approval.body: The draft reaches you before it's sent. Approve or correct with a reply.

howItWorks.heading: From voice note to delivered minutes.
howItWorks.sub: Five steps. You do two of them: record and approve.

record.title: Record a voice note
record.body: In the car, in the hallway, right after hanging up. In the chat you already have open.

transcribe.title: It gets transcribed
transcribe.body: The audio becomes text in seconds, in English or Spanish.

extract.title: The data gets extracted
extract.body: Date, attendees, decisions, action items: exactly your document's fields, validated against its schema.

approve.title: You approve it
approve.body: You review the draft in the chat and confirm, or ask for a quick correction.

deliver.title: It gets delivered
deliver.body: Your .docx template, filled in, converted to PDF and sent to the right person.

useCases.heading: For the team that's out in the field, not in the meeting room.
useCases.sub: Any document that always has the same sections can be dictated.

minutes.title: Meeting minutes
minutes.body: Meetings with clients, suppliers or your own team. Attendees, agenda, decisions and action items with owners, in your format.

visit.title: Sales visit reports
visit.body: The rep dictates the visit from the car. The report reaches the manager before the rep reaches the office.

custom.title: Any report with fixed fields
custom.body: Service call reports, technical reports, call summaries. Set up as one more document type from the panel, no code.

differentiator.heading: It's not a bot that sneaks into your video call.
differentiator.paragraph: Otter, Fireflies or Fathom need a scheduled video call with a link. Most of your sales visits and calls don't have one. ReportAI works from a voice note recorded afterwards and turns it into the document with the exact format your company already uses.

rows.noCall: Works without a video call or a link
rows.afterVisit: Built for in-person visits and phone calls
rows.ownTemplate: Fills in your own Word template
rows.chat: Used from the chat you already have

differentiator.kicker: None of this is needed. Just a voice note.

templateFidelity.heading: Your template, not ours.
templateFidelity.paragraph: You upload the .docx your company already uses. ReportAI fills in those same fields, in that same format. No generic PDF with your logo pasted on top.
templateFidelity.check: Before a template goes live, the panel checks that the fields it contains match the document type's. If one is missing, it tells you.

values.attendees: James Whitfield, Sarah Mitchell, Marcus Reed, Emily Chen
values.summary: Quarterly order +15% with two-week delivery and renewal of the maintenance contract.

approval.heading: Nothing goes out without your approval.
approval.paragraph1: Every report goes through mandatory human review before it's delivered. If something's off, you correct it with a simple reply and ReportAI generates it again.
approval.paragraph2: By default, everything goes through Telegram. WhatsApp Business and inbound email are available too; Slack or Microsoft Teams are set up on request.

onboarding.heading: Getting set up is a conversation, not a project.
onboarding.sub: Every deployment is built to fit, with us. Here's what happens:

tell.title: You tell us which documents you produce
tell.body: You send us your .docx template and who should receive each report.

configure.title: We configure it with you
configure.body: Document types, fields, channel and the people allowed to send. All of it visible in your panel.

first.title: Your team sends the first voice note
first.body: And the first minutes land in the right inbox. We fine-tune whatever's needed on real documents.

onboarding.panelLabel: What you see in your panel

install.q: Do we have to install anything?
install.a: No. Your team sends the voice note from the chat they already have open. You only authorise their numbers or accounts in the panel.

channels.q: Which channels does it work on?
channels.a: Telegram by default. WhatsApp Business and inbound email are available too. Slack or Microsoft Teams are set up when a client needs them.

errors.q: What if it gets something wrong?
errors.a: The draft reaches the chat before it's sent. You reply with the correction and it's generated again. On top of that, every field is validated against your document's schema: a date has to be a date, a list has to be a list.

data.a: Templates and generated documents are stored on a private server, not in a third-party service. Audio transcription and field extraction use AI APIs (Groq and Anthropic). Each company has its own isolated space.

languages.q: Which languages does it work in?
languages.a: English and Spanish out of the box. The real example on this page exists in both.

documents.q: Is it only for meeting minutes?
documents.a: No. Any document with fixed sections: visit reports, service call reports, call summaries. Each document type is defined from the panel with its template and its fields.

price.a: It depends on volume and on what needs to be set up. Write to us with your template and we'll tell you what it would take, no strings attached.

finalCta.headline: Send a voice note. Get the minutes back.
finalCta.sub: The example above is real. The next one could come from your template.
